quantity: Slope of the DiD outcome on standardized hearing engagement dose among opposition questioners (pp per within-committee SD).
population: Opposition-party legislator-ministry pairs present in both audits.
comparison: Per SD of hearing question dyads directed at the nominee.
supporting_result: Slope of at least +2.5pp per SD.
decisive_metric: Pooled slope and 95 percent interval, committee FE, SEs clustered by legislator.
falsifying_result: 95 percent interval excludes +2.5pp per SD and includes zero, with 150 or more opposition units.
claim_scope: Intensity margin within the opposition only.

lit_a.quoted_prediction: Contrary to the conventional wisdom that confrontation crowds out information, we show that members of the president's party engage in less confrontational oversight and reveal no more or less information than their peers.

claims.quantity: Opposed-minus-supportive difference-in-differences in the share of a legislator's audit question dyads directed at the confirmed nominee's ministry (percentage points).
claims.population: Legislator-ministry pairs present in the same committee's audit before and after a minister-level confirmation hearing, 21st Assembly.
claims.period: Cohort 1 hearings Dec 2020 to May 2021 (audits Oct 2020 and Oct 2021) and cohort 2 hearings May to Oct 2023 (audits Oct 2022 and Oct 2023).
claims.comparison: Opposed vs supportive questioners, after minus before.
claims.decisive_metric: Pooled DiD point estimate and 95 percent interval, committee FE, SEs clustered by legislator.
claims.falsifying_result: 95 percent interval excludes +5pp and includes zero, with placebo agencies showing the same before-after pattern.
claims.claim_scope: Audit allocation toward the confirmed ministry only, party-line opposition coding.

spec_plan.model: OLS on standardized dose, committee FE, clustered by legislator
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A slope below +2.5pp per SD would mean continuity fails at the intensity margin too.

spec_plan.model: OLS on standardized dose, committee FE, clustered by legislator
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A dose slope on placebo agencies would mean the dose tilt is generic engagement, not ministry-directed.

spec_plan.outcome_def: change in confirmed-ministry share of audit question dyads
spec_plan.model: OLS of the before-after change in share on opposed, committee FE, SEs clustered by legislator
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A positive DiD under a government change would mean carry-over is regime-contingent.

spec_plan.outcome_def: change in confirmed-ministry share, permuted within assembly term
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: An estimate of similar size on permuted outcomes would mean the primary estimate is produced by the specification, not the data.
A sign that flips across subsamples would mean a few legislators carry the estimate.
